A '''Pet-Sized Cupcake''' is a {{Legendary}} consumable. It is unlocked from the [[Raffle of the Century]] during Year 500.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Pet-Sized Cupcake''' is a {{Gold|'''MEDIUM'''}} reward from the Year 500 [[Raffle of the Century]].

== Usage ==
A '''Pet-Sized Cupcake''' can be used on a [[Pet]] to instantly grant enough [[Pet Exp]] to max its level. '''Pet-Sized Cupcakes''' cannot be given to a {{Item|Wisp Pet}} and max level pets.
